definitions.matched: Header is considered matched when normalized API identity and behavior are equivalent to baseline with only accepted normalizations.
accepted_normalizations: Namespace partition reshaping without API behavior change
Equivalent typedef spelling that preserves ABI/signature
Calling convention spelling aliases that compile to same ABI
Constant literal representation differences (hex vs decimal) with same value
Macro expansion form differences with equivalent emitted metadata

stop_conditions: Missing declaration owner header cannot be located after targeted search
Parser bug in windows-rs blocks correct emission
Ambiguous ownership semantics requiring spec decision
Patch fails to apply cleanly after rebase and cannot be safely auto-resolved
Generated metadata regression outside accepted normalizations
escalation_rules: If header-only declaration fix is clear, route to header_patch and continue
If failure is parser/consumer behavior, route to windows_rs_parser and open linked issue/task entry
If blocker persists >2 attempts, set status=blocked with assumption and evidence, then move to next header
Record every assumption in assumptions[] with timestamp and rationale
